verses.1: And these are the names of the Israelites who came from Egypt: Jacob and his household.
verses.5: And every soul that came out of Jacob’s path was seventy in number. Joseph, however, remained in Egypt.
verses.6: And Joseph and all his brothers, as well as the entire family, died.
verses.7: And the children of Israel ate and became numerous. They multiplied greatly, and the land was filled with them.
verses.8: And a new king was appointed over Egypt, who did not know Joseph at all.
verses.9: And he said to his people, “Look! The people of Israel are now numerous and powerful compared to us.”
verses.10: She waited for him, so that he wouldn’t get tired. It would be like a war, and he would also attack those who hate us and fight against us. He would rise from the ground.
verses.11: And they set up barriers over him, so that he could be punished in their midst. They also built cities of danger for Pharaoh, along with his army.
verses.12: And when they respond to him in this way, he will become more powerful and will be able to break through. Then the Israelites will be defeated by him.
verses.13: And the Egyptians served the children of Israel with pleasure.
verses.14: They wasted their lives on hard labor in the fields, working with straw and clay. They did all kinds of hard work in the fields, just as they had done before.
verses.15: And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew girls: “The name of one of them was Shifra, and the name of the other was Puah.”
verses.16: And he said, “In the children, look for the signs. See if they are boys or girls. If they are boys, then give them a name. And if they are girls, then let them live.”
verses.17: And the women saw the God, and they did not do what the king of Egypt said. So they became happy with their children.
verses.18: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives and said to them, “Why have you done this? Why have you given life to these children?”
verses.19: And the women said to Pharaoh, “It is not like the Egyptian women who are still alive right now. They were still alive before the woman who will give birth to children came into their midst.”
verses.20: And God blessed the women, and the people multiplied greatly.
verses.21: And when the girls saw the God, they built houses for Him.
verses.22: And Pharaoh commanded all his people, “Every boy who is born on the first day of the month shall be thrown out, and every girl shall be put to death.”
